headline: FLOOR BOSS: the night shift is open
lede: A new original management sim lands on the Plaicraft robot kit — run a robot warehouse floor against the clock: layout, dispatch, jams, breakdowns and rush hour, with throughput as the scoreboard.

notes.text: FLOOR BOSS shipped (#1144): conveyor, stow arm, pallet racks, hauler robots and a shipping dock in one pointer-first sim. Tap a bot, tap a rack, ship orders before they expire. Private for now — Jon lists it when ready.

The floor fights back: aisles JAM until you back a bot off, worn robots stop until you turbo-repair them, and a full floor stalls the belt at the intake. Three expired orders and the boss fires you mid-shift.

The whole sim is seeded and deterministic — same seed + same inputs hashes identically in Node and Chrome, every shift saves a Plaicraft episode, and the harness proves the CPU floor manager clears quota on every seed it tries.
